rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Section Two, point 1: the Constitution enters into force on the day of its official publication following the popular vote; the day of the popular vote is deemed the day of its adoption; the 1978 Constitution (Basic Law) of the Russian Federation - Russia, as amended, ceases to have effect at the same time.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Section Two, point 3: the President of the Russian Federation elected under the Constitution (Basic Law) of the Russian Federation - Russia exercises, from the day this Constitution enters into force, the powers it establishes until the expiry of the term for which he was elected.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Article 80(1): the President of the Russian Federation is the head of state; Article 80(4) adds that as head of state he represents the Russian Federation at home and abroad.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Article 81: four-year term, not more than two consecutive terms. Article 82: on assuming office the President takes the printed oath to the people, in a solemn setting in the presence of members of the Federation Council, State Duma deputies and Constitutional Court judges. Article 92(1): the President begins to exercise his powers from the moment of taking the oath and ceases when the newly elected President takes the oath; 92(2) early cessation on resignation, persistent incapacity or removal; 92(3) the Chairman of the Government temporarily performs the duties.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
